card.line: Mount Gilboa is a mountain range east of the plain of Jezreel, where Saul and his sons died in battle against the Philistines.

moments.title: Saul camps at Gilboa
moments.text: The Philistines camped at Shunem, and Saul gathered all Israel and camped at Gilboa. When Saul saw the Philistine army, he was afraid and trembled violently.

moments.title: Saul and his sons die
moments.text: The men of Israel fled, and many fell on Mount Gilboa. The Philistines killed Saul's sons, and Saul fell on his own sword, dying with his three sons that day.

moments.title: The Philistines find Saul
moments.text: The next day the Philistines came to strip the dead and found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa. They cut off Saul's head and took his armor.

moments.title: The Amalekite's story
moments.text: A young man told David that he had been on Mount Gilboa and saw Saul leaning on his spear. He said he killed Saul at Saul's request and brought Saul's crown to David.

moments.title: David's song of sorrow
moments.text: David sang a sad song for Saul and Jonathan. He spoke to the mountains of Gilboa, where Saul's shield was dirtied, and said, "How the mighty have fallen!"
